term: constitutive content complete for nature identity
definition: A supplied content : Principle → Respect → Prop distinguishes its principle values: pointwise equivalence of content implies equality of the represented nature values. It does not assert that qualitative agreement is numerical identity of beings.
note: A proposed independent extensional account of nature; reading an essence as a complete constitutive account motivates the question but does not establish its completeness in positive/formal/eminent perfections. Neither intrinsic explanatory adequacy nor unreceived-esse applicability follows.
